target: templates/workflows/factory.js review-prompt region — names forge.sh push and pr-create, says PR/MR, keeps the pr-open handoff
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"
J="$PLUGIN_ROOT/templates/workflows/factory.js"
sed -n '/@agentic-loop:begin region=review-prompt/,/@agentic-loop:end region=review-prompt/p' "$J" > region.txt
fx_has region.txt 'REVIEW_PROMPT' region_found
fx_has region.txt 'forge.sh push' names_push
fx_has region.txt 'pr-create' names_prcreate
fx_has region.txt 'git push -u origin' stale_push
fx_has region.txt 'PR/MR' says_prmr
